issue.body:
_For the space time I looked into fixing csv generation for es|ql in Discover. I couldn't complete it during that time and also think that a broader discussion on the technical direction is needed. I took the time to learn how csv generation and es|ql in Discover work; created [a hacky/dirty poc](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/173389) to find what is missing, and I am creating the issue to kick of the discussion:_

---


Currently, when you export a CSV from Discover using ES|QL, it doesn't work properly. The CSV is made with regular query DSL language, not ES|QL, so the data in the CSV looks different from what you see in Discover.

Currently the ES|QL implementation in Discover is a lot simpler than the regular search pipeline (hopefully it can stay this way ;)). It doesn't really use SearchSource, DataViews, FieldFormats. ES|QL doesn't support pagination, async search, point in time.

[Current implementation](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/blob/37af741c6e03afe9dc877600fe47960b5bac8f50/packages/kbn-generate-csv/src/generate_csv.ts) of CSV generation code from discover is pretty complex because it reimplements the regular search pipeline from Discover and uses all of the mentioned above complex services and concepts. 


**Proposed Approach (up to discussion / preliminary):** 

Since how different es|ql and query dsl pipelines in Discover are, I think we could consider keeping the es|ql csv generation separate from the [existing](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/blob/37af741c6e03afe9dc877600fe47960b5bac8f50/packages/kbn-generate-csv/src/generate_csv.ts) csv generation:

- [ ] Create a new csv report type for es|ql generation 
  -  Keep it simple as es|ql in Discover. 
  - Reuse common csv generation code where makes sense (e.g. formula detection) and reuse csv settings that are still relevant for the new type
  - Try to share the code with discover for table data generation (learn from past mistakes)
 - [ ] Make sure the cell formatting is the same as in Discover (How does it work now?)
    - [ ] Figure out how the timezone should work. es|ql doesn't support timezone yet and it seems we can't reuse existing field formats logic directly 
 - [ ] Make sure that dynamically generated from the ES|QL columns work
 - [ ] Make sure that client-side column state from Discover is reflected in the CSV
 - [ ] Make sure relative date timefilter works 
   -  Currently there is bug that when generating an CSV from Discover it sends two identical time range filters: one relative and one absolute. 
   -  ES|QL filter seem to be broken when relative time is used https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/103455
   -  Make sure that CSV generate can work with relative time filter as it is needed for the watcher/interval use-case
- [ ] Make sure generating from saved searches works
- [ ] Make sure Copy Post URL option works
- [ ] Make sure advanced CSV settings like timeouts, formulas, bom, max size work
- [ ] Make sure reporting's logger / errors / warnings still work
- [ ] Make sure transport settings like maxRetries and requestTimeout are configured correctly
- [ ] Please make sure to update all documentation points including these, and any others I may have missed that you can think of:
  - [ES|QL Limitations Page](https://www.elastic.co/guide/en/elasticsearch/reference/8.11/esql-limitations.html) - The Kibana Limitations section should contain a bullet to note that the row limitation also applies to CSV Exports.


**Alternative approach 1**

In an alternative approach we can re-use existing CSV generation pipeline shortcutting the functionality that is currently not need for ES|QL. This would look similar to my [quick and hacky poc](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/173389)

**Alternative 2**

We can also consider replacing the ES|QL CSV generating using reporting with client-side generation. We can re-use or do something similar to what ES|QL visualization does. This could be considered, as currently ES|QL is limited to just 10000 rows and has no pagination. Basically what user see in the discover table can be exported into an CSV directly. 

The downside of this approach is that it won't support the "Copy POST URL" option for calling generation from outside Kibana or from Watcher.

We could consider this as short term option. Later if/when ES|QL gets the SearchSource / DataView / FieldFormats / pagination support, we will use the reporting plugin pipeline for generating an CSV. 


---

For the very short term, we should consider hiding CSV option for ES|QL in Discover since it doesn't work correctly. 





cc @stratoula, @tsullivan

issue.title: Fix now in millis for ESQL search contexts

labels.name: Team:QL (Deprecated)
labels.description: Meta label for query languages team

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
Currently, ESQL search contexts do not have the correct actual 'now' in milliseconds. Ideally, we should use a consistent 'now' in millis for all nodes participating in the execution of a search request. I will follow up with a PR to deserialize that value between nodes for version 8.13 and later.

Closes #103455
